text: 检查尸体时，你意识到自己犯下了可怕的错误。你被荒诞的想象冲昏头脑，杀害了一个再普通不过的人。
进行理智检定：若失败，损失1D6点理智。然后前往105。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 103
text: In examining the body, you realize you have made a terrible mistake. Carried away by wild imaginings, you have murdered a perfectly ordinary person.
Make a Sanity roll: if you fail, lose 1D6 Sanity. Then, go to 105.
